messages:
maria-finops: Heads up — spotted a customer with an unapplied credit after a partial refund in Stripe. Stripe shows a refund for ch_1G9X... but NetSuite has no applied credit. Customer balance still shows as paid. Anyone seen this before?

sam-eng: ugh. do you have the stripe refund id? I can check the webhook logs.

maria-finops: refund id rf_1HkZ2..., charge ch_1G9X..., customer cus_A12D. Stripe's UI shows partial refund for $40 on a $100 invoice.

levi-billing: netsuite-sync-bot popped a DLQ yesterday for refund.apply missing_invoice for that customer. maybe the connector couldn't map to the invoice. :thinking:

netsuite-sync-bot: DLQ entry created: refund.apply error -> missing invoice reference; payload truncated: {"refund_id":"rf_1HkZ2","charge":"ch_1G9X","amount":4000} 

sam-eng: looking at our webhook logs — the event we processed was charge.refunded, but the payload didn't include invoice id for partial refunds (Stripe sometimes omits invoice on partial refund events). code path expects invoice id to apply credit.

ana-acct: if we don't apply to the original invoice we should at minimum create a credit memo tied to the customer AR account. That way they don't get double-billed.

levi-billing: agree. current mapping logic: 
```
if (payload.invoice_id) {
  applyCreditToInvoice(payload.invoice_id, amount)
} else {
  throw new Error('missing_invoice')
}
```
we never fall back to customer-level credit.

maria-finops: that explains it. downstream GL shows revenue reversed but AR unchanged. We need a quick mitigation so any refunds without invoice get created as credit memos in NetSuite.

sam-eng: quick patch idea: detect refund events missing invoice, call payments.search by charge id to find original payment -> retrieve linked invoice id. If still not found, create customer-level credit memo. I can open a PR for this morning.

levi-billing: sounds good. two follow-ups: 1) add instrumentation so we can alert when refunds go to DLQ for missing_invoice, 2) reconcile script to find refunds in Stripe that don't have applied credits in NetSuite (historical window last 30 days).

maria-finops: +1 on reconciliation script. I'll collect a sample list (we have 12 affected customers so far) and escalate for recouping the credits.

sam-eng: FYI here's the minimal payload we saw in the webhook (sanitized):
```
{
  "id": "evt_3Jx6",
  "type": "charge.refunded",
  "data": {
    "object": {
      "id": "ch_1G9X",
      "refunded": true,
      "refunds": {"data":[{"id":"rf_1HkZ2","amount":4000}]}
      // note: no "invoice" field for the partial refund event
    }
  }
}
```

ana-acct: for the reconciliation job please include columns: stripe_refund_id, stripe_charge_id, stripe_invoice_id (if any), netsuite_credit_id, netsuite_invoice_applied, customer_id, discrepancy_amount, notes.

levi-billing: I'll add DLQ alerting (PagerDuty to billing-oncall) and a short runbook: on missing_invoice -> run reconciliation, create credit memo, link, and mark DLQ processed.

maria-finops: timeline? this is impacting active customers, want a fix + reconciliation run today if possible.

sam-eng: I'll have a hotfix PR by EOD, deploy to staging for a smoke test, and then to prod after sign-off. creating Jira BR-1142.

levi-billing: tagging @ana-acct for approval on creating credit memos in NS without invoice link — we need accounting sign-off for policy.

ana-acct: I approve temporary fallback to create customer credit memos for partial refunds without invoice. We'll book an adjusting entry during month close as needed. Please include memo text: 'Auto-created credit from Stripe refund rf_1HkZ2 — partial refund applied, no invoice id in webhook.'

maria-finops: thanks. I'll add the 12 customers to the reconciliation ticket and check for materiality. :thumbsup:

sam-eng: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/commit/7b2d... (draft). moving to QA now.

netsuite-sync-bot: Action: created Jira BR-1142, enqueued DLQ reprocess job.

levi-billing: once PR is live we'll run the 30-day backfill and close out the DLQ items. I'll post run results in this thread.

maria-finops: perfect — thanks team.
